google/veo-3.1-lite.review_note: This is one controlled, policy-compliant prompt experiment after repeated terminal provider no-output receipts. Author the positive_prompt exactly as supplied below. Keep it camera-only and do not name or describe any visible subject, body part, device, activity, relationship, health topic, or brand.

topology_anchors: The positive_prompt must be exactly: "Slow centered zoom in."
contacts: Do not introduce or change source contacts.

image_reading: One smiling woman sits cross-legged on a sofa and looks down at an orange smartphone held in both hands.
Her right index finger is poised at or touching the phone screen; the device-hand contact and intended interface action are visually delicate.
The woman, sofa, cushions, wall art, fireplace, books, and decorative objects form a stable indoor composition with no other people visible.
analysis.article_context: The body image supports the advice to prepare questions before a medical consultation so important health concerns are not overlooked.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Quiet, organized preparation helps a person record questions before a medical consultation and avoid overlooking important concerns.
structured_intent.initial_state: One smiling woman is seated cross-legged on a sofa, looking down while holding an orange smartphone with both hands and keeping one index finger near its screen.
structured_intent.primary_action: A restrained centered push-in toward the existing composition.
structured_intent.attention_anchor: The seated woman holding the orange smartphone.
structured_intent.motion_boundary: Only the camera may move; the woman, phone, hands, screen state, sofa, cushions, furnishings, wall art, and all other source-defined regions remain source-locked, with no new space or entities introduced.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The same composition is modestly closer while the seated woman and smartphone remain centered, fully recognizable, and continuously visible.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: Preserve the woman's seated body geometry, finger and hand placement, phone-hand contacts, and the rigid geometry of the sofa and room.
structured_intent.identity_invariant: Keep exactly one woman, one orange smartphone, the same visible limbs, clothing, cushions, furnishings, and decorative objects.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The calm, attentive sense of preparing and organizing information remains unchanged through the final frame.
structured_intent.feasibility_assessment: The seated pose, gaze toward the phone, and hand-device contact are visible, but a reliable tap, typing sequence, or interface response cannot be inferred from one frame; a bounded camera-only treatment is safer.

models.scene_plan: Over four seconds, execute one smooth centered push-in at an even pace, keeping the current framing and its focal subject centered and continuously visible. Limit total screen travel to about 5%, reveal no unseen space, and ease gently into the final closer composition.
